context: Treemap of D3 Power Tools skill files grouped by category, where cell area encodes line count of each skill's SKILL.md file
first_impression: Structurally honest treemap — area encoding is mathematically correct via d3.hierarchy().sum() and the subtitle explicitly declares the encoding contract.
what_works: d3.treemap().sum(d => d.lines) correctly maps area to data values with no hardcoded domains; within-category color lightness (t = d.value / maxLines) adds a redundant but honest secondary encoding
what_doesnt: Within-category lightness shading can mislead cross-category comparisons (a dim cell in a large category may have more lines than a bright cell in a small one); fixed width/height (1100×640) are layout constants not data domains, which is fine, but leaves no robustness against viewport-driven rescaling edge cases
